title: 黏滯阻尼器性能驗證
summary: 從附加阻尼的性能目標出發，建立 F = C·v^α 的非線性本構與麥斯威爾串聯模型，檢查缸體耐壓與密封，再走過逐件出廠試驗、現場安裝的行程預算與置中、原型試驗的頻率與溫升、完工系統識別，最後談長期抽樣復驗與地震後評估，並以 Torre Mayor、台灣高鐵雲林段高架橋與倫敦千禧橋的公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from supplemental-damping performance targets, build the nonlinear law F = C·v^α and the Maxwell series model, check cylinder pressure and seals, then work through production testing of every unit, stroke budgets and centring at installation, prototype frequency and temperature-rise tests and post-completion system identification, and finally long-term sample re-testing and post-earthquake assessment, compared with public information on Torre Mayor, the Taiwan High Speed Rail Yunlin viaduct and London's Millennium Bridge.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 驗收練習：規格 C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4。出廠試驗以振幅 u₀ = 50 mm、頻率 f = 1.0 Hz 的正弦位移進行，尖峰速度 v = 2π×1.0×0.05 ≈ 0.314 m/s，預期尖峰力 F = 1,500×0.314^0.4 ≈ 944 kN。非線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = λ·C·u₀^(1+α)·ω^α，α = 0.4 時 λ ≈ 3.58，E ≈ 3.58×1,500×0.0151×2.09 ≈ 169 kJ。若量得迴圈面積 152 kJ，偏差 −10%，在 ±15% 內可允收；若只有 140 kJ（約 −17%）則不合格。若改用在 0.314 m/s 時同樣出力的線性阻尼器（C ≈ 3,005 kN·s/m），每循環耗能 π·F·u₀ ≈ 148 kJ；速度加倍到 0.628 m/s 時線性阻尼器力約 1,888 kN，α = 0.4 的阻尼器只有約 1,246 kN，斜撐與接頭的設計力相差約 34%。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際產品或專案。
workedExample.textEn: Acceptance exercise: the specification is C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4. A production test uses sinusoidal displacement with amplitude u₀ = 50 mm at f = 1.0 Hz, so peak velocity is v = 2π×1.0×0.05 ≈ 0.314 m/s and the expected peak force is F = 1,500×0.314^0.4 ≈ 944 kN. A nonlinear damper dissipates E = λ·C·u₀^(1+α)·ω^α per cycle, with λ ≈ 3.58 for α = 0.4, so E ≈ 3.58×1,500×0.0151×2.09 ≈ 169 kJ. A measured loop area of 152 kJ is −10% and acceptable within ±15%; 140 kJ (about −17%) fails. A linear damper giving the same force at 0.314 m/s (C ≈ 3,005 kN·s/m) dissipates π·F·u₀ ≈ 148 kJ per cycle; if velocity doubles to 0.628 m/s the linear damper produces about 1,888 kN while the α = 0.4 damper produces about 1,246 kN, a difference of about 34% in brace and connection design force. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real product or project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「附加阻尼的性能目標」與「非線性黏滯本構與阻尼指數」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Performance targets for supplemental damping" and "Nonlinear viscous law and damping exponent": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Performance targets for supplemental damping: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「附加阻尼比」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Supplemental damping ratio” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。設計者通常以附加阻尼比表示目標，例如把總阻尼由約 5% 提高到 20% 至 30%，以降低層間變位與樓板加速度。墨西哥市 57 層的 Torre Mayor 設有 98 具流體黏滯阻尼器，製造商公開說明它在 2003 年規模 7.6 與 2017 年規模 7.1 地震中均無損傷。性能驗證的核心，是確認每一具阻尼器真的提供設計所假設的力—速度關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「附加阻尼比」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces. Designers usually express the target as supplemental damping, for example raising total damping from about 5% to 20% to 30% to cut storey drift and floor acceleration. The 57-storey Torre Mayor in Mexico City has 98 fluid viscous dampers, and the manufacturer reports no damage in the magnitude 7.6 earthquake of 2003 or the magnitude 7.1 earthquake of 2017. The core of performance verification is confirming that every damper actually delivers the force–velocity relation assumed in design. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Supplemental damping ratio” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「附加阻尼比」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Supplemental damping ratio”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標
knowledge.text: 流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。設計者通常以附加阻尼比表示目標，例如把總阻尼由約 5% 提高到 20% 至 30%，以降低層間變位與樓板加速度。
knowledge.textEn: A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces. Designers usually express the target as supplemental damping, for example raising total damping from about 5% to 20% to 30% to cut storey drift and floor acceleration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「附加阻尼的性能目標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Performance targets for supplemental damping" is correct?
options: 加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。
流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。
阻尼指數 α 越小越好，因為最大力被限制住了。
optionsEn: Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase.

A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces.
The smaller the damping exponent α the better, because the peak force is capped.
quiz.explanation: 流體黏滯阻尼器的力與速度同相、與位移相差 90 度：結構位移最大時速度為零，阻尼力也接近零，因此能在不明顯增加柱與基礎最大內力的情況下增加耗能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A fluid viscous damper's force is in phase with velocity and 90 degrees out of phase with displacement: at peak displacement the velocity is zero and so is the damping force, so energy dissipation rises without markedly increasing peak column and foundation forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Performance targets for supplemental damping: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「附加阻尼比」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Supplemental damping ratio” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。固有阻尼 5% 加附加阻尼 20%，ξ = 25%，η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58，設計譜位移約降為 5% 阻尼時的 58%；若實際附加阻尼只有 15%，η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63，位移增加約 10%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55. With 5% inherent plus 20% supplemental damping, ξ = 25% and η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58, so design spectral displacement falls to about 58% of the 5%-damped value; if only 15% supplemental damping is achieved, η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63 and displacement rises by about 10%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。固有阻尼 5% 加附加阻尼 20%，ξ = 25%，η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58，設計譜位移約降為 5% 阻尼時的 58%；若實際附加阻尼只有 15%，η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63，位移增加約 10%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55. With 5% inherent plus 20% supplemental damping, ξ = 25% and η = √(10/30) ≈ 0.58, so design spectral displacement falls to about 58% of the 5%-damped value; if only 15% supplemental damping is achieved, η = √(10/25) ≈ 0.63 and displacement rises by about 10%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「附加阻尼的性能目標」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Performance targets for supplemental damping", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。
黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。
Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。
optionsEn: A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness.
A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force.
The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55.
quiz.explanation: Eurocode 8 阻尼修正係數 η = √(10/(5+ξ))（ξ 以 % 計，η ≥ 0.55）。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The Eurocode 8 damping correction factor is η = √(10/(5+ξ)) with ξ in percent and η ≥ 0.55. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 附加阻尼的性能目標：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Performance targets for supplemental damping: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「附加阻尼比」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Supplemental damping ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構計算書要附阻尼器需求表與編號對照圖，並在設計說明中寫明附加阻尼比、性能目標與允許性質變異範圍，讓試驗單位與審查者能直接比對。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The structural calculations should attach the damper demand table and a numbered location plan, and the design basis should state the supplemental damping ratio, performance targets and allowed property variation so that test laboratories and reviewers can compare directly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只用等效阻尼比做線性分析，而沒有算出每具阻尼器的速度與行程，試驗規格可能低估最大速度，使阻尼器在設計地震時超過額定力或觸底，失去耗能並對接頭產生衝擊力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Linear analysis with an equivalent damping ratio alone, without computing each damper's velocity and stroke, can lead to test specifications that underestimate peak velocity, so dampers exceed rated force or bottom out in the design earthquake, losing dissipation and hammering their connections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。
knowledge.textEn: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構計算書要附阻尼器需求表與編號對照圖，並在設計說明中寫明附加阻尼比、性能目標與允許性質變異範圍，讓試驗單位與審查者能直接比對。
knowledge.textEn: The structural calculations should attach the damper demand table and a numbered location plan, and the design basis should state the supplemental damping ratio, performance targets and allowed property variation so that test laboratories and reviewers can compare directly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「附加阻尼的性能目標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Performance targets for supplemental damping"?
options: 設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
optionsEn: At design stage, compare storey drift, floor acceleration and damper force, stroke and velocity with and without dampers using nonlinear time-history analysis, and produce a demand table for every damper (peak force, peak velocity, peak stroke, energy per earthquake) as the basis for later test specifications and acceptance criteria.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 設計階段以非線性時間歷程分析比較有無阻尼器時的層間變位、樓板加速度與阻尼器力、行程與速度，產出每一具阻尼器的需求表（最大力、最大速度、最大行程、每次地震的耗能），作為後續試驗規格與允收標準的依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 非線性黏滯本構與阻尼指數：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Nonlinear viscous law and damping exponent: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「力—速度曲線」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force–velocity curve” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 黏滯阻尼器的力通常寫成 F = C·|v|^α·sgn(v)，C 為阻尼常數、α 為阻尼指數。α = 1 為線性阻尼，力與速度成正比；建築耐震常用 α 約 0.3 至 0.5，速度增加時力增加有限，可控制傳到斜撐、接頭與構架的最大力。製造商以孔口設計調整 C 與 α，Taylor Devices 公開的指數範圍約 0.3 至 2.0。非線性也意味著小速度時力相對較大，風振或溫度造成的緩慢變形都要檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「力—速度曲線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A viscous damper's force is usually written F = C·|v|^α·sgn(v), where C is the damping constant and α the damping exponent. With α = 1 the damper is linear and force is proportional to velocity; seismic building applications often use α of about 0.3 to 0.5, so force grows only modestly with velocity and the peak force sent to braces, connections and frames is capped. Manufacturers set C and α through orifice design, and Taylor Devices publishes an exponent range of about 0.3 to 2.0. Nonlinearity also means relatively large forces at low velocity, so slow deformations from wind or temperature must be checked. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Force–velocity curve” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4: at v = 0.25 m/s, F = 1,500×0.25^0.4 ≈ 862 kN; at 0.5 m/s about 1,137 kN; at 1.0 m/s 1,500 kN, so doubling velocity from 0.5 to 1.0 m/s raises force by only about 32%.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼指數 α 越小越好，因為最大力被限制住了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The smaller the damping exponent α the better, because the peak force is capped." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「力—速度曲線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Force–velocity curve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 非線性黏滯本構與阻尼指數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nonlinear viscous law and damping exponent: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「力—速度曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Force–velocity curve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4：v = 0.25 m/s 時 F = 1,500×0.25^0.4 ≈ 862 kN；v = 0.5 m/s 時約 1,137 kN；v = 1.0 m/s 時 1,500 kN，速度由 0.5 加倍到 1.0 m/s，力只增加約 32%。若為線性 C = 1,500 kN·s/m，同樣速度區間的力由 750 增為 1,500 kN。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4: at v = 0.25 m/s, F = 1,500×0.25^0.4 ≈ 862 kN; at 0.5 m/s about 1,137 kN; at 1.0 m/s 1,500 kN, so doubling velocity from 0.5 to 1.0 m/s raises force by only about 32%. A linear damper with C = 1,500 kN·s/m goes from 750 to 1,500 kN over the same range. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：原型試驗在至少三個速度（例如設計速度的 25%、50% 與 100%）下量測尖峰力，以對數座標擬合 log F = log C + α·log v 求出 C 與 α，並與規格比較；擬合殘差過大時，代表孔口或閥件在某速度區間行為改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Prototype tests measure peak force at no fewer than three velocities, for example 25%, 50% and 100% of the design velocity, and fit log F = log C + α·log v on log axes to obtain C and α for comparison with the specification; large fit residuals indicate that the orifice or valving changes behaviour in some velocity range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 原型試驗在至少三個速度（例如設計速度的 25%、50% 與 100%）下量測尖峰力，以對數座標擬合 log F = log C + α·log v 求出 C 與 α，並與規格比較；擬合殘差過大時，代表孔口或閥件在某速度區間行為改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Prototype tests measure peak force at no fewer than three velocities, for example 25%, 50% and 100% of the design velocity, and fit log F = log C + α·log v on log axes to obtain C and α for comparison with the specification; large fit residuals indicate that the orifice or valving changes behaviour in some velocity range. steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書要同時列出 C、α、設計速度、最大速度、最大行程與允收偏差，並要求試驗報告附力—速度擬合圖與殘差；變更 α 須重新分析結構並經設計者核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification must list C, α, design velocity, maximum velocity, maximum stroke and acceptance tolerance together, and require test reports to include the force–velocity fit and its residuals; any change to α requires reanalysis and the designer's approval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若採購規格只寫一個最大力而未寫 C 與 α，製造商可能交付線性阻尼器；在超過設計速度的近斷層脈衝下，線性阻尼器的力比預期大很多，使斜撐或節點板先破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the purchase specification gives only a maximum force without C and α, a linear damper may be delivered; under a near-fault pulse above the design velocity its force is far larger than expected and the brace or gusset fails first. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 非線性黏滯本構與阻尼指數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nonlinear viscous law and damping exponent: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「力—速度曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Force–velocity curve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若採購規格只寫一個最大力而未寫 C 與 α，製造商可能交付線性阻尼器；在超過設計速度的近斷層脈衝下，線性阻尼器的力比預期大很多，使斜撐或節點板先破壞。反之 α 過小時，小振幅下的力相對大，接頭在風振下累積疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the purchase specification gives only a maximum force without C and α, a linear damper may be delivered; under a near-fault pulse above the design velocity its force is far larger than expected and the brace or gusset fails first. Conversely, a very small α gives relatively high force at small amplitude, so connections accumulate fatigue under wind. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：非線性也意味著小速度時力相對較大，風振或溫度造成的緩慢變形都要檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nonlinearity also means relatively large forces at low velocity, so slow deformations from wind or temperature must be checked.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼指數 α 越小越好，因為最大力被限制住了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The smaller the damping exponent α the better, because the peak force is capped." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Conversely, a very small α gives relatively high force at small amplitude, so connections accumulate fatigue under wind.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「非線性黏滯本構與阻尼指數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Nonlinear viscous law and damping exponent" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要阻尼器外觀沒有油漬，內部一定沒有問題。
若採購規格只寫一個最大力而未寫 C 與 α，製造商可能交付線性阻尼器；在超過設計速度的近斷層脈衝下，線性阻尼器的力比預期大很多，使斜撐或節點板先破壞。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If a damper shows no oil stains outside, nothing can be wrong inside.
If the purchase specification gives only a maximum force without C and α, a linear damper may be delivered.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 材料、構件與接合細部
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「缸體耐壓、密封與流體」與「串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid" and "Series stiffness and the Maxwell model": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 缸體耐壓、密封與流體：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「缸體、活塞桿與矽油」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cylinder, piston rod and silicone fluid” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器由高強度鋼缸體、活塞桿、帶孔口的活塞與矽油組成，活塞移動時把油從一側推到另一側，高速流過孔口產生壓差，壓差乘以活塞有效面積就是阻尼力。矽油化學穩定、不易燃，黏度隨溫度變化較小，但性質仍會隨溫度改變，部分設計以雙金屬孔口補償。活塞桿進出會改變缸內容積，需要蓄壓空間或貫通桿設計；密封必須在高壓下長期不漏油，是阻尼器耐久的關鍵。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「缸體、活塞桿與矽油」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A damper consists of a high-strength steel cylinder, a piston rod, a piston with orifices and silicone fluid; as the piston moves it forces fluid from one side to the other, the high-speed flow through the orifices creates a pressure difference, and that pressure times the effective piston area is the damping force. Silicone fluid is chemically stable, non-flammable and relatively insensitive to temperature, yet its properties still change with temperature, and some designs compensate with bimetallic orifices. Rod entry changes the internal volume, so an accumulator space or through-rod design is needed; seals must hold high pressure without leaking for decades and are the key to durability. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Cylinder, piston rod and silicone fluid” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：活塞有效面積 A = π/4·(D² − d²)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The effective piston area is A = π/4·(D² − d²).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要阻尼器外觀沒有油漬，內部一定沒有問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a damper shows no oil stains outside, nothing can be wrong inside." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「缸體、活塞桿與矽油」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Cylinder, piston rod and silicone fluid”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 缸體耐壓、密封與流體
knowledge.text: 阻尼器由高強度鋼缸體、活塞桿、帶孔口的活塞與矽油組成，活塞移動時把油從一側推到另一側，高速流過孔口產生壓差，壓差乘以活塞有效面積就是阻尼力。矽油化學穩定、不易燃，黏度隨溫度變化較小，但性質仍會隨溫度改變，部分設計以雙金屬孔口補償。
knowledge.textEn: A damper consists of a high-strength steel cylinder, a piston rod, a piston with orifices and silicone fluid; as the piston moves it forces fluid from one side to the other, the high-speed flow through the orifices creates a pressure difference, and that pressure times the effective piston area is the damping force. Silicone fluid is chemically stable, non-flammable and relatively insensitive to temperature, yet its properties still change with temperature, and some designs compensate with bimetallic orifices.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要阻尼器外觀沒有油漬，內部一定沒有問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If a damper shows no oil stains outside, nothing can be wrong inside. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「缸體耐壓、密封與流體」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid" is correct?
options: 阻尼器由高強度鋼缸體、活塞桿、帶孔口的活塞與矽油組成，活塞移動時把油從一側推到另一側，高速流過孔口產生壓差，壓差乘以活塞有效面積就是阻尼力。
只要阻尼器外觀沒有油漬，內部一定沒有問題。
阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。
optionsEn: A damper consists of a high-strength steel cylinder, a piston rod, a piston with orifices and silicone fluid.
If a damper shows no oil stains outside, nothing can be wrong inside.
A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器由高強度鋼缸體、活塞桿、帶孔口的活塞與矽油組成，活塞移動時把油從一側推到另一側，高速流過孔口產生壓差，壓差乘以活塞有效面積就是阻尼力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A damper consists of a high-strength steel cylinder, a piston rod, a piston with orifices and silicone fluid; as the piston moves it forces fluid from one side to the other, the high-speed flow through the orifices creates a pressure difference, and that pressure times the effective piston area is the damping force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 缸體耐壓、密封與流體：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「缸體、活塞桿與矽油」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cylinder, piston rod and silicone fluid” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：活塞有效面積 A = π/4·(D² − d²)。取缸徑 D = 250 mm、桿徑 d = 100 mm，A = π/4×(0.0625 − 0.0100) ≈ 0.0412 m²；阻尼力 1,500 kN 時缸內壓差 p = F/A ≈ 1,500/0.0412 ≈ 36.4 MPa，以 1.5 倍做耐壓驗證約 54.6 MPa。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The effective piston area is A = π/4·(D² − d²). With bore D = 250 mm and rod d = 100 mm, A = π/4×(0.0625 − 0.0100) ≈ 0.0412 m²; a 1,500 kN damping force needs a pressure difference p = F/A ≈ 1,500/0.0412 ≈ 36.4 MPa, and a 1.5 times proof test is about 54.6 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：每具阻尼器出廠前做耐壓試驗，壓力高於地震與風作用下的最大內壓並保持規定時間，檢查無滲漏與永久變形；同時檢查缸體與活塞桿的材料證明、桿面硬化或鍍層厚度與表面粗糙度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before delivery, proof-test every damper above the maximum internal pressure expected under earthquake and wind and hold it for the specified time, checking for leakage and permanent deformation; also check mill certificates for the cylinder and rod, rod surface hardening or plating thickness and surface roughness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 活塞有效面積 A = π/4·(D² − d²)。取缸徑 D = 250 mm、桿徑 d = 100 mm，A = π/4×(0.0625 − 0.0100) ≈ 0.0412 m²；阻尼力 1,500 kN 時缸內壓差 p = F/A ≈ 1,500/0.0412 ≈ 36.4 MPa，以 1.5 倍做耐壓驗證約 54.6 MPa。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: The effective piston area is A = π/4·(D² − d²). With bore D = 250 mm and rod d = 100 mm, A = π/4×(0.0625 − 0.0100) ≈ 0.0412 m²; a 1,500 kN damping force needs a pressure difference p = F/A ≈ 1,500/0.0412 ≈ 36.4 MPa, and a 1.5 times proof test is about 54.6 MPa. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「缸體耐壓、密封與流體」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid", which statement holds?
options: 黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。
活塞有效面積 A = π/4·(D² − d²)。
用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
optionsEn: A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force.
The effective piston area is A = π/4·(D² − d²).
Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 活塞有效面積 A = π/4·(D² − d²)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The effective piston area is A = π/4·(D² − d²). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 缸體耐壓、密封與流體：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「缸體、活塞桿與矽油」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cylinder, piston rod and silicone fluid” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 每具阻尼器出廠前做耐壓試驗，壓力高於地震與風作用下的最大內壓並保持規定時間，檢查無滲漏與永久變形；同時檢查缸體與活塞桿的材料證明、桿面硬化或鍍層厚度與表面粗糙度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before delivery, proof-test every damper above the maximum internal pressure expected under earthquake and wind and hold it for the specified time, checking for leakage and permanent deformation; also check mill certificates for the cylinder and rod, rod surface hardening or plating thickness and surface roughness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝後活塞桿外露段要加保護罩，避免焊渣、油漆與水泥漿附著；阻尼器附近的現場焊接必須遮蔽，並禁止把阻尼器當作吊點或臨時支撐。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: After installation, fit a protective boot over the exposed rod to keep off weld spatter, paint and cement slurry; shield any site welding near the damper, and never use a damper as a lifting point or temporary support.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：密封在高壓與長期往復下磨耗，起初只是桿上油膜增加，逐漸變成可見漏油；油量減少後缸內出現空氣，力—位移遲滯迴圈在換向處出現缺角，阻尼力下降並可能產生衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Seals wear under high pressure and long reciprocation: at first the rod film thickens, then visible leakage appears; as fluid is lost air enters the cylinder, the force–displacement loop shows notches at reversal, damping force drops and impacts may occur. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 每具阻尼器出廠前做耐壓試驗，壓力高於地震與風作用下的最大內壓並保持規定時間，檢查無滲漏與永久變形；同時檢查缸體與活塞桿的材料證明、桿面硬化或鍍層厚度與表面粗糙度。
knowledge.textEn: Before delivery, proof-test every damper above the maximum internal pressure expected under earthquake and wind and hold it for the specified time, checking for leakage and permanent deformation; also check mill certificates for the cylinder and rod, rod surface hardening or plating thickness and surface roughness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 安裝後活塞桿外露段要加保護罩，避免焊渣、油漆與水泥漿附著；阻尼器附近的現場焊接必須遮蔽，並禁止把阻尼器當作吊點或臨時支撐。
knowledge.textEn: After installation, fit a protective boot over the exposed rod to keep off weld spatter, paint and cement slurry; shield any site welding near the damper, and never use a damper as a lifting point or temporary support.

quiz.question: 要驗證「缸體耐壓、密封與流體」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。
每具阻尼器出廠前做耐壓試驗，壓力高於地震與風作用下的最大內壓並保持規定時間，檢查無滲漏與永久變形。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
If a damper shows no leakage after an earthquake, it is completely undamaged.
Before delivery, proof-test every damper above the maximum internal pressure expected under earthquake and wind and hold it for the specified time, checking for leakage and permanent deformation.
quiz.explanation: 每具阻尼器出廠前做耐壓試驗，壓力高於地震與風作用下的最大內壓並保持規定時間，檢查無滲漏與永久變形；同時檢查缸體與活塞桿的材料證明、桿面硬化或鍍層厚度與表面粗糙度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before delivery, proof-test every damper above the maximum internal pressure expected under earthquake and wind and hold it for the specified time, checking for leakage and permanent deformation; also check mill certificates for the cylinder and rod, rod surface hardening or plating thickness and surface roughness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 缸體耐壓、密封與流體：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「缸體、活塞桿與矽油」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cylinder, piston rod and silicone fluid” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 密封在高壓與長期往復下磨耗，起初只是桿上油膜增加，逐漸變成可見漏油；油量減少後缸內出現空氣，力—位移遲滯迴圈在換向處出現缺角，阻尼力下降並可能產生衝擊。活塞桿表面刮傷會加速密封損壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Seals wear under high pressure and long reciprocation: at first the rod film thickens, then visible leakage appears; as fluid is lost air enters the cylinder, the force–displacement loop shows notches at reversal, damping force drops and impacts may occur. Scratches on the rod surface accelerate seal damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：活塞桿進出會改變缸內容積，需要蓄壓空間或貫通桿設計；密封必須在高壓下長期不漏油，是阻尼器耐久的關鍵。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rod entry changes the internal volume, so an accumulator space or through-rod design is needed; seals must hold high pressure without leaking for decades and are the key to durability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要阻尼器外觀沒有油漬，內部一定沒有問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a damper shows no oil stains outside, nothing can be wrong inside." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Scratches on the rod surface accelerate seal damage.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「缸體耐壓、密封與流體」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cylinder pressure, seals and fluid" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 密封在高壓與長期往復下磨耗，起初只是桿上油膜增加，逐漸變成可見漏油；油量減少後缸內出現空氣，力—位移遲滯迴圈在換向處出現缺角，阻尼力下降並可能產生衝擊。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Series stiffness and the Maxwell model: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「斜撐與節點板勁度」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brace and gusset stiffness” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器不是直接裝在樓層之間，而是透過斜撐、節點板、插銷與錨栓串聯到構架。這些元件的彈性與間隙會吃掉部分層間變形，使阻尼器實際行程小於理論值；可用麥斯威爾模型（阻尼器與彈簧串聯）描述，鬆弛時間 τ = C/K_b 越大，阻尼器在高頻下越像彈簧而不像阻尼器。插銷間隙在小振幅風振時特別關鍵，因為間隙可能與振幅同一量級。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「斜撐與節點板勁度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A damper is not fixed directly between floors but connected in series through a brace, gusset plates, pins and anchors. Their flexibility and clearances absorb part of the storey drift, so the damper's actual stroke is less than the theoretical value; this is described by a Maxwell model, a damper in series with a spring, where the larger the relaxation time τ = C/K_b, the more the damper behaves like a spring rather than a dashpot at higher frequency. Pin clearance matters most in small-amplitude wind response, where the gap may be of the same order as the motion. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Brace and gusset stiffness” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線性 C = 2,000 kN·s/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take a linear C = 2,000 kN·s/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「斜撐與節點板勁度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Brace and gusset stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Series stiffness and the Maxwell model

Their flexibility and clearances absorb part of the storey drift, so the damper's actual stroke is less than the theoretical value; this is described by a Maxwell model, a damper in series with a spring, where the larger the relaxation time τ = C/K_b, the more the damper behaves like a spring rather than a dashpot at higher frequency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Series stiffness and the Maxwell model" is correct?
options: 阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。
阻尼器不是直接裝在樓層之間，而是透過斜撐、節點板、插銷與錨栓串聯到構架。
同一批次阻尼器只要抽驗一具合格，其他都不必試驗。
optionsEn: A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness.
A damper is not fixed directly between floors but connected in series through a brace, gusset plates, pins and anchors.
If one damper from a batch passes, the rest of the batch need not be tested.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器不是直接裝在樓層之間，而是透過斜撐、節點板、插銷與錨栓串聯到構架。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A damper is not fixed directly between floors but connected in series through a brace, gusset plates, pins and anchors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Series stiffness and the Maxwell model: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「斜撐與節點板勁度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brace and gusset stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性 C = 2,000 kN·s/m。斜撐勁度 K_b = 200,000 kN/m 時 τ = 0.01 s，在 1.0 Hz 下 ωτ = 0.063，耗能為剛性斜撐時的 1/(1+0.063²) ≈ 99.6%；若 K_b 只有 40,000 kN/m，τ = 0.05 s，ωτ = 0.314，耗能降為約 91%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take a linear C = 2,000 kN·s/m. With brace stiffness K_b = 200,000 kN/m, τ = 0.01 s and at 1.0 Hz ωτ = 0.063, so dissipation is 1/(1+0.063²) ≈ 99.6% of the rigid-brace value; with K_b of only 40,000 kN/m, τ = 0.05 s, ωτ = 0.314 and dissipation falls to about 91%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以元件試驗或有限元素分析求出斜撐、節點板與錨栓的串聯勁度並納入結構模型；現場量測插銷與銷孔直徑，確認間隙不超過規格（例如 0.5 mm 以內），完工後再以小振幅激振確認阻尼器確實產生相對位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the series stiffness of brace, gusset and anchors from component tests or finite-element analysis and include it in the structural model; measure pin and hole diameters on site to confirm clearance within specification, for example 0.5 mm, and after completion use small-amplitude excitation to confirm that the dampers actually stroke.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 線性 C = 2,000 kN·s/m。斜撐勁度 K_b = 200,000 kN/m 時 τ = 0.01 s，在 1.0 Hz 下 ωτ = 0.063，耗能為剛性斜撐時的 1/(1+0.063²) ≈ 99.6%；若 K_b 只有 40,000 kN/m，τ = 0.05 s，ωτ = 0.314，耗能降為約 91%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Take a linear C = 2,000 kN·s/m. With brace stiffness K_b = 200,000 kN/m, τ = 0.01 s and at 1.0 Hz ωτ = 0.063, so dissipation is 1/(1+0.063²) ≈ 99.6% of the rigid-brace value; with K_b of only 40,000 kN/m, τ = 0.05 s, ωτ = 0.314 and dissipation falls to about 91%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Series stiffness and the Maxwell model", which statement holds?
options: 地震只有幾十秒，阻尼器不必考慮發熱問題。
黏滯阻尼器是密封元件，設計壽命內不需要任何檢查或試驗。
線性 C = 2,000 kN·s/m。
optionsEn: An earthquake lasts only tens of seconds, so damper heating can be ignored.
A viscous damper is a sealed unit, so it needs no inspection or testing during its design life.
Take a linear C = 2,000 kN·s/m.
quiz.explanation: 線性 C = 2,000 kN·s/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Take a linear C = 2,000 kN·s/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Series stiffness and the Maxwell model: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斜撐與節點板勁度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brace and gusset stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以元件試驗或有限元素分析求出斜撐、節點板與錨栓的串聯勁度並納入結構模型；現場量測插銷與銷孔直徑，確認間隙不超過規格（例如 0.5 mm 以內），完工後再以小振幅激振確認阻尼器確實產生相對位移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain the series stiffness of brace, gusset and anchors from component tests or finite-element analysis and include it in the structural model; measure pin and hole diameters on site to confirm clearance within specification, for example 0.5 mm, and after completion use small-amplitude excitation to confirm that the dampers actually stroke. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：圖說應規定斜撐最小軸向勁度、插銷間隙與球面軸承規格，接頭設計力取阻尼器最大力乘上超強係數；製造與安裝檢查表要逐具記錄插銷間隙。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Drawings should specify minimum brace axial stiffness, pin clearance and spherical-bearing requirements, with connections designed for the maximum damper force times an overstrength factor; fabrication and installation checklists must record pin clearance for every unit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：斜撐太柔或節點板面外挫屈時，層間變形大多被斜撐吸收，阻尼器幾乎不動作，結構實際阻尼遠低於設計；插銷間隙過大則在風振時只有敲擊沒有耗能，並造成噪音與疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the brace is too flexible or the gusset buckles out of plane, the brace absorbs most of the drift, the damper barely moves and real damping falls far below design; excessive pin clearance produces knocking instead of dissipation under wind, with noise and fatigue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以元件試驗或有限元素分析求出斜撐、節點板與錨栓的串聯勁度並納入結構模型；現場量測插銷與銷孔直徑，確認間隙不超過規格（例如 0.5 mm 以內），完工後再以小振幅激振確認阻尼器確實產生相對位移。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain the series stiffness of brace, gusset and anchors from component tests or finite-element analysis and include it in the structural model; measure pin and hole diameters on site to confirm clearance within specification, for example 0.5 mm, and after completion use small-amplitude excitation to confirm that the dampers actually stroke.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 圖說應規定斜撐最小軸向勁度、插銷間隙與球面軸承規格，接頭設計力取阻尼器最大力乘上超強係數；製造與安裝檢查表要逐具記錄插銷間隙。
knowledge.textEn: Drawings should specify minimum brace axial stiffness, pin clearance and spherical-bearing requirements, with connections designed for the maximum damper force times an overstrength factor; fabrication and installation checklists must record pin clearance for every unit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Series stiffness and the Maxwell model"?
options: 以元件試驗或有限元素分析求出斜撐、節點板與錨栓的串聯勁度並納入結構模型。

Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase.
quiz.explanation: 以元件試驗或有限元素分析求出斜撐、節點板與錨栓的串聯勁度並納入結構模型；現場量測插銷與銷孔直徑，確認間隙不超過規格（例如 0.5 mm 以內），完工後再以小振幅激振確認阻尼器確實產生相對位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain the series stiffness of brace, gusset and anchors from component tests or finite-element analysis and include it in the structural model; measure pin and hole diameters on site to confirm clearance within specification, for example 0.5 mm, and after completion use small-amplitude excitation to confirm that the dampers actually stroke. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Series stiffness and the Maxwell model: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜撐與節點板勁度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brace and gusset stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 斜撐太柔或節點板面外挫屈時，層間變形大多被斜撐吸收，阻尼器幾乎不動作，結構實際阻尼遠低於設計；插銷間隙過大則在風振時只有敲擊沒有耗能，並造成噪音與疲勞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the brace is too flexible or the gusset buckles out of plane, the brace absorbs most of the drift, the damper barely moves and real damping falls far below design; excessive pin clearance produces knocking instead of dissipation under wind, with noise and fatigue. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：插銷間隙在小振幅風振時特別關鍵，因為間隙可能與振幅同一量級。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pin clearance matters most in small-amplitude wind response, where the gap may be of the same order as the motion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「串聯勁度與麥斯威爾模型」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Series stiffness and the Maxwell model" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
斜撐太柔或節點板面外挫屈時，層間變形大多被斜撐吸收，阻尼器幾乎不動作，結構實際阻尼遠低於設計；插銷間隙過大則在風振時只有敲擊沒有耗能，並造成噪音與疲勞。
同一批次阻尼器只要抽驗一具合格，其他都不必試驗。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If the brace is too flexible or the gusset buckles out of plane, the brace absorbs most of the drift, the damper barely moves and real damping falls far below design.
If one damper from a batch passes, the rest of the batch need not be tested.
quiz.explanation: 斜撐太柔或節點板面外挫屈時，層間變形大多被斜撐吸收，阻尼器幾乎不動作，結構實際阻尼遠低於設計；插銷間隙過大則在風振時只有敲擊沒有耗能，並造成噪音與疲勞。 需以量測區分可能原因。

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收」與「現場安裝、行程預算與置中」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance" and "Site installation, stroke budget and centring": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「逐件出廠試驗」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Production test of every unit” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 原型試驗證明設計可行，逐件出廠試驗則證明每一具都和原型一樣。常見做法是在試驗機上以正弦位移在設計頻率附近做數個循環，量測力—位移遲滯迴圈：迴圈面積代表每循環耗能，零位移時的力代表最大阻尼力，迴圈形狀則能看出空氣、摩擦或間隙。Taylor Devices 公開說明，每具結構用阻尼器都會動態試驗到規格最大力並隨貨附試驗報告。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「逐件出廠試驗」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Prototype tests prove the design; production tests prove that every unit matches the prototype. A common procedure applies several sinusoidal displacement cycles near the design frequency on a test machine and records the force–displacement hysteresis loop: the loop area is the energy dissipated per cycle, the force at zero displacement is the peak damping force, and the loop shape reveals air, friction or free play. Taylor Devices states that every structural damper it supplies is dynamically tested to its maximum specified force and shipped with a test report. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Production test of every unit” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = π·C·ω·u₀²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A linear damper dissipates E = π·C·ω·u₀² per cycle.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一批次阻尼器只要抽驗一具合格，其他都不必試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If one damper from a batch passes, the rest of the batch need not be tested." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「逐件出廠試驗」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Production test of every unit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收

knowledge.textEn: Prototype tests prove the design; production tests prove that every unit matches the prototype. A common procedure applies several sinusoidal displacement cycles near the design frequency on a test machine and records the force–displacement hysteresis loop: the loop area is the energy dissipated per cycle, the force at zero displacement is the peak damping force, and the loop shape reveals air, friction or free play.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一批次阻尼器只要抽驗一具合格，其他都不必試驗。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If one damper from a batch passes, the rest of the batch need not be tested. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance" is correct?
options: 同一批次阻尼器只要抽驗一具合格，其他都不必試驗。
黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。
原型試驗證明設計可行，逐件出廠試驗則證明每一具都和原型一樣。
optionsEn: If one damper from a batch passes, the rest of the batch need not be tested.
A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force.
Prototype tests prove the design; production tests prove that every unit matches the prototype.
quiz.explanation: 原型試驗證明設計可行，逐件出廠試驗則證明每一具都和原型一樣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Prototype tests prove the design; production tests prove that every unit matches the prototype. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「逐件出廠試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Production test of every unit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = π·C·ω·u₀²。C = 2,000 kN·s/m、u₀ = 50 mm、f = 0.5 Hz（ω = 3.14 rad/s）時 E = π×2,000×3.14×0.0025 ≈ 49.3 kJ；若量得迴圈面積 45.0 kJ，反算 C_eq = 45.0/(π×3.14×0.0025) ≈ 1,824 kN·s/m，偏差 −8.8%，在 ±15% 允收範圍內。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A linear damper dissipates E = π·C·ω·u₀² per cycle. With C = 2,000 kN·s/m, u₀ = 50 mm and f = 0.5 Hz (ω = 3.14 rad/s), E = π×2,000×3.14×0.0025 ≈ 49.3 kJ; a measured loop area of 45.0 kJ gives C_eq = 45.0/(π×3.14×0.0025) ≈ 1,824 kN·s/m, a deviation of −8.8%, inside a ±15% acceptance band. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：試驗前確認荷重元與位移計的校正可追溯至國家標準，報告須記錄試驗溫度；每具阻尼器的 C_eq、零位移力與最大行程與原型平均值比較，並由業主代表或第三方見證抽樣試驗，見證紀錄與序號一併歸檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before testing, confirm that load-cell and displacement-transducer calibrations are traceable to national standards, and record test temperature in the report; compare each unit's C_eq, zero-displacement force and maximum stroke with the prototype average, and have the owner's representative or a third party witness a sample of tests, filing witness records with serial numbers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = π·C·ω·u₀²。C = 2,000 kN·s/m、u₀ = 50 mm、f = 0.5 Hz（ω = 3.14 rad/s）時 E = π×2,000×3.14×0.0025 ≈ 49.3 kJ；若量得迴圈面積 45.0 kJ，反算 C_eq = 45.0/(π×3.14×0.0025) ≈ 1,824 kN·s/m，偏差 −8.8%，在 ±15% 允收範圍內。數值為教學假設。

With C = 2,000 kN·s/m, u₀ = 50 mm and f = 0.5 Hz (ω = 3.14 rad/s), E = π×2,000×3.14×0.0025 ≈ 49.3 kJ; a measured loop area of 45.0 kJ gives C_eq = 45.0/(π×3.14×0.0025) ≈ 1,824 kN·s/m, a deviation of −8.8%, inside a ±15% acceptance band. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance", which statement holds?
options: 線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = π·C·ω·u₀²。
用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。
optionsEn: A linear damper dissipates E = π·C·ω·u₀² per cycle.
Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake.
If a damper shows no leakage after an earthquake, it is completely undamaged.
quiz.explanation: 線性阻尼器每循環耗能 E = π·C·ω·u₀²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A linear damper dissipates E = π·C·ω·u₀² per cycle. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「逐件出廠試驗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Production test of every unit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 試驗前確認荷重元與位移計的校正可追溯至國家標準，報告須記錄試驗溫度；每具阻尼器的 C_eq、零位移力與最大行程與原型平均值比較，並由業主代表或第三方見證抽樣試驗，見證紀錄與序號一併歸檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before testing, confirm that load-cell and displacement-transducer calibrations are traceable to national standards, and record test temperature in the report; compare each unit's C_eq, zero-displacement force and maximum stroke with the prototype average, and have the owner's representative or a third party witness a sample of tests, filing witness records with serial numbers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：採購合約要求逐件試驗、見證點與試驗報告格式（含序號、溫度、迴圈圖、C_eq 與偏差），不合格品不得以修正係數放行；試驗報告須與現場安裝位置一一對照。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The purchase contract should require testing of every unit, witness points and a report format with serial number, temperature, loop plot, C_eq and deviation; failed units must not be released with correction factors, and each test report must be matched to its installed location.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只抽驗少數樣品而不逐件試驗，混入一具組裝時孔口錯置或灌油不足的阻尼器，地震時可能只有一半的力；試驗時若未記錄溫度，夏季現場的實際阻尼與冬季出廠試驗的差異將無從判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only a few samples instead of every unit lets a damper with a misplaced orifice or incomplete fill slip through, delivering perhaps half its force in an earthquake; without recorded test temperatures, differences between summer site behaviour and winter factory tests cannot be judged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 試驗前確認荷重元與位移計的校正可追溯至國家標準，報告須記錄試驗溫度；每具阻尼器的 C_eq、零位移力與最大行程與原型平均值比較，並由業主代表或第三方見證抽樣試驗，見證紀錄與序號一併歸檔。
knowledge.textEn: Before testing, confirm that load-cell and displacement-transducer calibrations are traceable to national standards, and record test temperature in the report; compare each unit's C_eq, zero-displacement force and maximum stroke with the prototype average, and have the owner's representative or a third party witness a sample of tests, filing witness records with serial numbers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 採購合約要求逐件試驗、見證點與試驗報告格式（含序號、溫度、迴圈圖、C_eq 與偏差），不合格品不得以修正係數放行；試驗報告須與現場安裝位置一一對照。

quiz.question: 要驗證「出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
試驗前確認荷重元與位移計的校正可追溯至國家標準，報告須記錄試驗溫度。
阻尼指數 α 越小越好，因為最大力被限制住了。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Before testing, confirm that load-cell and displacement-transducer calibrations are traceable to national standards, and record test temperature in the report.
The smaller the damping exponent α the better, because the peak force is capped.
quiz.explanation: 試驗前確認荷重元與位移計的校正可追溯至國家標準，報告須記錄試驗溫度；每具阻尼器的 C_eq、零位移力與最大行程與原型平均值比較，並由業主代表或第三方見證抽樣試驗，見證紀錄與序號一併歸檔。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before testing, confirm that load-cell and displacement-transducer calibrations are traceable to national standards, and record test temperature in the report; compare each unit's C_eq, zero-displacement force and maximum stroke with the prototype average, and have the owner's representative or a third party witness a sample of tests, filing witness records with serial numbers. steps.title: 出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「逐件出廠試驗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Production test of every unit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只抽驗少數樣品而不逐件試驗，混入一具組裝時孔口錯置或灌油不足的阻尼器，地震時可能只有一半的力；試驗時若未記錄溫度，夏季現場的實際阻尼與冬季出廠試驗的差異將無從判斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only a few samples instead of every unit lets a damper with a misplaced orifice or incomplete fill slip through, delivering perhaps half its force in an earthquake; without recorded test temperatures, differences between summer site behaviour and winter factory tests cannot be judged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Taylor Devices 公開說明，每具結構用阻尼器都會動態試驗到規格最大力並隨貨附試驗報告。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Taylor Devices states that every structural damper it supplies is dynamically tested to its maximum specified force and shipped with a test report.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一批次阻尼器只要抽驗一具合格，其他都不必試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If one damper from a batch passes, the rest of the batch need not be tested." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出廠試驗與遲滯迴圈驗收」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Production testing and hysteresis-loop acceptance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。
若只抽驗少數樣品而不逐件試驗，混入一具組裝時孔口錯置或灌油不足的阻尼器，地震時可能只有一半的力。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force.
Testing only a few samples instead of every unit lets a damper with a misplaced orifice or incomplete fill slip through, delivering perhaps half its force in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若只抽驗少數樣品而不逐件試驗，混入一具組裝時孔口錯置或灌油不足的阻尼器，地震時可能只有一半的力；試驗時若未記錄溫度，夏季現場的實際阻尼與冬季出廠試驗的差異將無從判斷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only a few samples instead of every unit lets a damper with a misplaced orifice or incomplete fill slip through, delivering perhaps half its force in an earthquake; without recorded test temperatures, differences between summer site behaviour and winter factory tests cannot be judged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 現場安裝、行程預算與置中：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Site installation, stroke budget and centring: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「行程中心與安裝溫度」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stroke centre and installation temperature” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器通常在主結構完成後才安裝，讓施工期間的收縮、潛變與自重變形不佔用行程；安裝時活塞要放在依當時溫度推算的位置，使之後的溫度伸縮與地震行程都在可用範圍內。台灣高鐵雲林段高架橋在伸縮縫設置 34 具約 4,000 kN 的流體黏滯阻尼器，行程約 ±5 in（±127 mm），用來控制地震與列車煞車時的運動；緩慢的溫度伸縮速度極低、阻尼力很小，卻會移動行程中心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「行程中心與安裝溫度」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dampers are usually installed after the main structure is complete so that shrinkage, creep and self-weight deformation during construction do not consume stroke; at installation the piston is set at a position calculated for the current temperature so that later thermal movement and seismic stroke both stay within the available range. The Taiwan High Speed Rail viaduct in Yunlin has 34 fluid viscous dampers of about 4,000 kN at expansion joints, with about ±5 in (±127 mm) stroke, to control movement in earthquakes and train braking; slow thermal movement is so slow that damping force is small, yet it shifts the stroke centre. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Stroke centre and installation temperature” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×60 m×40°C = 24 mm，在平均溫度置中時佔 ±12 mm；加上地震行程 ±100 mm，共 ±112 mm，小於 ±127 mm，餘裕 15 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×60 m×40°C = 24 mm, or ±12 mm when centred at mean temperature; adding ±100 mm of seismic stroke gives ±112 mm, inside ±127 mm with 15 mm to spare.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「行程中心與安裝溫度」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Stroke centre and installation temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「現場安裝、行程預算與置中」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Site installation, stroke budget and centring" is correct?
options: 阻尼器通常在主結構完成後才安裝，讓施工期間的收縮、潛變與自重變形不佔用行程；安裝時活塞要放在依當時溫度推算的位置，使之後的溫度伸縮與地震行程都在可用範圍內。

quiz.explanationEn: Dampers are usually installed after the main structure is complete so that shrinkage, creep and self-weight deformation during construction do not consume stroke; at installation the piston is set at a position calculated for the current temperature so that later thermal movement and seismic stroke both stay within the available range. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 現場安裝、行程預算與置中：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Site installation, stroke budget and centring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行程中心與安裝溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stroke centre and installation temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫度伸縮 ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×60 m×40°C = 24 mm，在平均溫度置中時佔 ±12 mm；加上地震行程 ±100 mm，共 ±112 mm，小於 ±127 mm，餘裕 15 mm。若在最高溫時以中點安裝，最低溫時偏移 24 mm，總需求 124 mm，餘裕只剩 3 mm。L、ΔT 與地震行程為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT = 1.0×10⁻⁵×60 m×40°C = 24 mm, or ±12 mm when centred at mean temperature; adding ±100 mm of seismic stroke gives ±112 mm, inside ±127 mm with 15 mm to spare. Centring at the hottest temperature shifts the piston 24 mm at the coldest, so total demand is 124 mm and only 3 mm remains. L, ΔT and the seismic stroke are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前量測構件溫度並依圖表計算活塞目標位置，安裝後量測實際外露桿長並拍照記錄；之後於冬夏兩季複測桿長，確認溫度移動量與預測一致，並檢查是否有施工遺留的偏心或扭轉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation, measure member temperature and compute the target piston position from the chart; after installation, measure and photograph the exposed rod length; re-measure rod length in winter and summer to confirm thermal movement matches prediction and to check for eccentricity or twist left from construction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Centring at the hottest temperature shifts the piston 24 mm at the coldest, so total demand is 124 mm and only 3 mm remains. L, ΔT and the seismic stroke are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「現場安裝、行程預算與置中」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Site installation, stroke budget and centring", which statement holds?
options: 黏滯阻尼器是密封元件，設計壽命內不需要任何檢查或試驗。
