steps.title: 現場安裝、行程預算與置中：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Site installation, stroke budget and centring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「行程中心與安裝溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stroke centre and installation temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 安裝前量測構件溫度並依圖表計算活塞目標位置，安裝後量測實際外露桿長並拍照記錄；之後於冬夏兩季複測桿長，確認溫度移動量與預測一致，並檢查是否有施工遺留的偏心或扭轉。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation, measure member temperature and compute the target piston position from the chart; after installation, measure and photograph the exposed rod length; re-measure rod length in winter and summer to confirm thermal movement matches prediction and to check for eccentricity or twist left from construction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：安裝程序要寫明安裝時段、量測溫度、目標桿長表、允許偏差與運輸鎖定件的拆除時點，並設為停止點，經結構設計者或監造簽認後才可拆除鎖定件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The installation procedure should state the installation window, temperature measurement, target rod-length table, tolerances and when transport locks are removed, set as a hold point so that locks come off only after the structural designer or site supervisor signs off.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若在構架仍在收縮或溫度極端時安裝而未置中，地震時活塞可能撞到端部，產生極大衝擊力並損壞端蓋與接頭；安裝角度偏差或插銷不同軸，則讓活塞桿承受彎矩並刮傷密封。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Installing without centring while the frame is still shrinking or at an extreme temperature lets the piston hit its end stop in an earthquake, producing huge impact forces that damage end caps and connections; angular misalignment or non-coaxial pins put bending into the rod and score the seals. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「現場安裝、行程預算與置中」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Site installation, stroke budget and centring"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要阻尼器外觀沒有油漬，內部一定沒有問題。
安裝前量測構件溫度並依圖表計算活塞目標位置，安裝後量測實際外露桿長並拍照記錄。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
If a damper shows no oil stains outside, nothing can be wrong inside.
Before installation, measure member temperature and compute the target piston position from the chart.
quiz.explanation: 安裝前量測構件溫度並依圖表計算活塞目標位置，安裝後量測實際外露桿長並拍照記錄；之後於冬夏兩季複測桿長，確認溫度移動量與預測一致，並檢查是否有施工遺留的偏心或扭轉。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before installation, measure member temperature and compute the target piston position from the chart; after installation, measure and photograph the exposed rod length; re-measure rod length in winter and summer to confirm thermal movement matches prediction and to check for eccentricity or twist left from construction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 現場安裝、行程預算與置中：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Site installation, stroke budget and centring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「行程中心與安裝溫度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stroke centre and installation temperature” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若在構架仍在收縮或溫度極端時安裝而未置中，地震時活塞可能撞到端部，產生極大衝擊力並損壞端蓋與接頭；安裝角度偏差或插銷不同軸，則讓活塞桿承受彎矩並刮傷密封。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Installing without centring while the frame is still shrinking or at an extreme temperature lets the piston hit its end stop in an earthquake, producing huge impact forces that damage end caps and connections; angular misalignment or non-coaxial pins put bending into the rod and score the seals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：台灣高鐵雲林段高架橋在伸縮縫設置 34 具約 4,000 kN 的流體黏滯阻尼器，行程約 ±5 in（±127 mm），用來控制地震與列車煞車時的運動；緩慢的溫度伸縮速度極低、阻尼力很小，卻會移動行程中心。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The Taiwan High Speed Rail viaduct in Yunlin has 34 fluid viscous dampers of about 4,000 kN at expansion joints, with about ±5 in (±127 mm) stroke, to control movement in earthquakes and train braking; slow thermal movement is so slow that damping force is small, yet it shifts the stroke centre.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若在構架仍在收縮或溫度極端時安裝而未置中，地震時活塞可能撞到端部，產生極大衝擊力並損壞端蓋與接頭；安裝角度偏差或插銷不同軸，則讓活塞桿承受彎矩並刮傷密封。
knowledge.textEn: Installing without centring while the frame is still shrinking or at an extreme temperature lets the piston hit its end stop in an earthquake, producing huge impact forces that damage end caps and connections; angular misalignment or non-coaxial pins put bending into the rod and score the seals.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「現場安裝、行程預算與置中」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Site installation, stroke budget and centring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若在構架仍在收縮或溫度極端時安裝而未置中，地震時活塞可能撞到端部，產生極大衝擊力並損壞端蓋與接頭；安裝角度偏差或插銷不同軸，則讓活塞桿承受彎矩並刮傷密封。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
地震只有幾十秒，阻尼器不必考慮發熱問題。
optionsEn: Installing without centring while the frame is still shrinking or at an extreme temperature lets the piston hit its end stop in an earthquake, producing huge impact forces that damage end caps and connections.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
An earthquake lasts only tens of seconds, so damper heating can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 若在構架仍在收縮或溫度極端時安裝而未置中，地震時活塞可能撞到端部，產生極大衝擊力並損壞端蓋與接頭；安裝角度偏差或插銷不同軸，則讓活塞桿承受彎矩並刮傷密封。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Installing without centring while the frame is still shrinking or at an extreme temperature lets the piston hit its end stop in an earthquake, producing huge impact forces that damage end caps and connections; angular misalignment or non-coaxial pins put bending into the rod and score the seals. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」與「完工系統識別與實測驗證」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation" and "Post-completion system identification and field verification": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「原型試驗與溫升」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Prototype tests and temperature rise” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 原型試驗要證明阻尼器在各種實際條件下都在允許變異內：不同頻率與振幅、不同環境溫度，以及長時間連續耗能造成的自體溫升。地震只有數十個大循環但每循環耗能大；風振則是數千個小循環，總熱量可能更多。油溫升高使黏度下降、阻尼力降低，因此試驗要量測外殼與油溫並記錄性質變化，設計者再以性質上下限（例如 ±15%）做結構分析的包絡檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「原型試驗與溫升」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Prototype tests must show that the damper stays within allowed variation under realistic conditions: different frequencies and amplitudes, different ambient temperatures and the self-heating caused by long continuous dissipation. An earthquake has only tens of large cycles with high energy per cycle, whereas wind imposes thousands of small cycles whose total heat can be greater. Hotter fluid has lower viscosity and less damping force, so tests measure casing and fluid temperature and track property changes, and designers then bound the structural analysis with upper and lower properties, for example ±15%. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Prototype tests and temperature rise” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：溫升 ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Temperature rise ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震只有幾十秒，阻尼器不必考慮發熱問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An earthquake lasts only tens of seconds, so damper heating can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「原型試驗與溫升」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Prototype tests and temperature rise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能
knowledge.titleEn: Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation
knowledge.text: 原型試驗要證明阻尼器在各種實際條件下都在允許變異內：不同頻率與振幅、不同環境溫度，以及長時間連續耗能造成的自體溫升。地震只有數十個大循環但每循環耗能大；風振則是數千個小循環，總熱量可能更多。
knowledge.textEn: Prototype tests must show that the damper stays within allowed variation under realistic conditions: different frequencies and amplitudes, different ambient temperatures and the self-heating caused by long continuous dissipation. An earthquake has only tens of large cycles with high energy per cycle, whereas wind imposes thousands of small cycles whose total heat can be greater.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地震只有幾十秒，阻尼器不必考慮發熱問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An earthquake lasts only tens of seconds, so damper heating can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation" is correct?
options: 地震只有幾十秒，阻尼器不必考慮發熱問題。
原型試驗要證明阻尼器在各種實際條件下都在允許變異內：不同頻率與振幅、不同環境溫度，以及長時間連續耗能造成的自體溫升。
用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
optionsEn: An earthquake lasts only tens of seconds, so damper heating can be ignored.

Prototype tests must show that the damper stays within allowed variation under realistic conditions: different frequencies and amplitudes, different ambient temperatures and the self-heating caused by long continuous dissipation.
Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 原型試驗要證明阻尼器在各種實際條件下都在允許變異內：不同頻率與振幅、不同環境溫度，以及長時間連續耗能造成的自體溫升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Prototype tests must show that the damper stays within allowed variation under realistic conditions: different frequencies and amplitudes, different ambient temperatures and the self-heating caused by long continuous dissipation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原型試驗與溫升」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Prototype tests and temperature rise” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：溫升 ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c)。鋼材 400 kg（c = 460 J/kg·K）加矽油 20 kg（c = 1,500 J/kg·K），合計熱容 214 kJ/K；地震 20 個循環、每循環 49.3 kJ，ΔT ≈ 987/214 ≈ 4.6°C；風振 2,000 個循環、每循環 5 kJ，若不計散熱，ΔT ≈ 10,000/214 ≈ 47°C。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Temperature rise ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c). Steel of 400 kg (c = 460 J/kg·K) plus 20 kg of silicone fluid (c = 1,500 J/kg·K) give a heat capacity of 214 kJ/K; 20 earthquake cycles of 49.3 kJ give ΔT ≈ 987/214 ≈ 4.6°C, while 2,000 wind cycles of 5 kJ, ignoring heat loss, give ΔT ≈ 10,000/214 ≈ 47°C. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依 ASCE 7 第 18 章或 EN 15129 的精神規劃原型試驗：多個頻率與振幅的循環、最低與最高設計溫度下的試驗，以及連續循環的耐久與溫升試驗；比較每組試驗的 C 與 α 是否落在允許包絡內，並在試驗後拆檢密封。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plan prototype tests in the spirit of ASCE 7 Chapter 18 or EN 15129: cycles at several frequencies and amplitudes, tests at the minimum and maximum design temperatures, and continuous-cycling endurance and temperature-rise tests; check that C and α from each series fall within the allowed envelope, and dismantle and inspect the seals afterwards.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 溫升 ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c)。鋼材 400 kg（c = 460 J/kg·K）加矽油 20 kg（c = 1,500 J/kg·K），合計熱容 214 kJ/K；地震 20 個循環、每循環 49.3 kJ，ΔT ≈ 987/214 ≈ 4.6°C；風振 2,000 個循環、每循環 5 kJ，若不計散熱，ΔT ≈ 10,000/214 ≈ 47°C。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature rise ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c). Steel of 400 kg (c = 460 J/kg·K) plus 20 kg of silicone fluid (c = 1,500 J/kg·K) give a heat capacity of 214 kJ/K; 20 earthquake cycles of 49.3 kJ give ΔT ≈ 987/214 ≈ 4.6°C, while 2,000 wind cycles of 5 kJ, ignoring heat loss, give ΔT ≈ 10,000/214 ≈ 47°C. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation", which statement holds?
options: 地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。
阻尼指數 α 越小越好，因為最大力被限制住了。
溫升 ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c)。
optionsEn: If a damper shows no leakage after an earthquake, it is completely undamaged.
The smaller the damping exponent α the better, because the peak force is capped.
Temperature rise ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c).
quiz.explanation: 溫升 ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature rise ΔT ≈ ΣE/(Σm·c). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原型試驗與溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Prototype tests and temperature rise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 ASCE 7 第 18 章或 EN 15129 的精神規劃原型試驗：多個頻率與振幅的循環、最低與最高設計溫度下的試驗，以及連續循環的耐久與溫升試驗；比較每組試驗的 C 與 α 是否落在允許包絡內，並在試驗後拆檢密封。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plan prototype tests in the spirit of ASCE 7 Chapter 18 or EN 15129: cycles at several frequencies and amplitudes, tests at the minimum and maximum design temperatures, and continuous-cycling endurance and temperature-rise tests; check that C and α from each series fall within the allowed envelope, and dismantle and inspect the seals afterwards. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：結構分析必須以試驗得到的性質上限與下限各跑一次：下限檢查位移與行程，上限檢查阻尼器力、斜撐與接頭；原型試驗報告須經設計者審查核可後才可量產。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Run the structural analysis once with the tested upper-bound properties and once with the lower bound: the lower bound checks displacement and stroke, the upper bound checks damper force, braces and connections; production starts only after the designer has reviewed and approved the prototype test report.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若原型試驗只在室溫下做短時間循環，風振長時間作用下油溫升高、阻尼力衰減，或密封在高溫下老化，實際性質超出分析假設的下限；寒冷地區的低溫則使力超過上限，接頭設計不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If prototype tests are only short runs at room temperature, long wind events heat the fluid and reduce force, or seals age at high temperature, so real properties fall below the analysis lower bound; low temperatures in cold climates push force above the upper bound and overload under-designed connections. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 ASCE 7 第 18 章或 EN 15129 的精神規劃原型試驗：多個頻率與振幅的循環、最低與最高設計溫度下的試驗，以及連續循環的耐久與溫升試驗；比較每組試驗的 C 與 α 是否落在允許包絡內，並在試驗後拆檢密封。
knowledge.textEn: Plan prototype tests in the spirit of ASCE 7 Chapter 18 or EN 15129: cycles at several frequencies and amplitudes, tests at the minimum and maximum design temperatures, and continuous-cycling endurance and temperature-rise tests; check that C and α from each series fall within the allowed envelope, and dismantle and inspect the seals afterwards.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 結構分析必須以試驗得到的性質上限與下限各跑一次：下限檢查位移與行程，上限檢查阻尼器力、斜撐與接頭；原型試驗報告須經設計者審查核可後才可量產。
knowledge.textEn: Run the structural analysis once with the tested upper-bound properties and once with the lower bound: the lower bound checks displacement and stroke, the upper bound checks damper force, braces and connections; production starts only after the designer has reviewed and approved the prototype test report.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation"?

量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
阻尼器的效果只取決於阻尼器本身，與斜撐和接頭勁度無關。

Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「原型試驗與溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prototype tests and temperature rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若原型試驗只在室溫下做短時間循環，風振長時間作用下油溫升高、阻尼力衰減，或密封在高溫下老化，實際性質超出分析假設的下限；寒冷地區的低溫則使力超過上限，接頭設計不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If prototype tests are only short runs at room temperature, long wind events heat the fluid and reduce force, or seals age at high temperature, so real properties fall below the analysis lower bound; low temperatures in cold climates push force above the upper bound and overload under-designed connections. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：油溫升高使黏度下降、阻尼力降低，因此試驗要量測外殼與油溫並記錄性質變化，設計者再以性質上下限（例如 ±15%）做結構分析的包絡檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hotter fluid has lower viscosity and less damping force, so tests measure casing and fluid temperature and track property changes, and designers then bound the structural analysis with upper and lower properties, for example ±15%.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地震只有幾十秒，阻尼器不必考慮發熱問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An earthquake lasts only tens of seconds, so damper heating can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: If prototype tests are only short runs at room temperature, long wind events heat the fluid and reduce force, or seals age at high temperature, so real properties fall below the analysis lower bound; low temperatures in cold climates push force above the upper bound and overload under-designed connections.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「原型試驗：頻率、溫度與長時間耗能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Prototype tests: frequency, temperature and long-duration dissipation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若原型試驗只在室溫下做短時間循環，風振長時間作用下油溫升高、阻尼力衰減，或密封在高溫下老化，實際性質超出分析假設的下限。
用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If prototype tests are only short runs at room temperature, long wind events heat the fluid and reduce force, or seals age at high temperature, so real properties fall below the analysis lower bound.
Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake.
quiz.explanation: 若原型試驗只在室溫下做短時間循環，風振長時間作用下油溫升高、阻尼力衰減，或密封在高溫下老化，實際性質超出分析假設的下限；寒冷地區的低溫則使力超過上限，接頭設計不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If prototype tests are only short runs at room temperature, long wind events heat the fluid and reduce force, or seals age at high temperature, so real properties fall below the analysis lower bound; low temperatures in cold climates push force above the upper bound and overload under-designed connections. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 完工系統識別與實測驗證：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-completion system identification and field verification: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「構架附加阻尼識別」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frame added-damping identification” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 阻尼器逐件合格不等於整個結構得到設計的附加阻尼，因為斜撐勁度、插銷間隙與非結構構件都會影響。完工後可用強制振動、拉放試驗或強震紀錄辨識結構頻率與阻尼比；非線性阻尼器的等效阻尼隨振幅改變，環境微振動只能檢查有無卡死或間隙，真正的附加阻尼要在較大振幅下驗證。倫敦千禧橋加裝阻尼裝置後，Arup 以約 2,000 人的控制行走試驗確認側向擺動已被抑制，就是系統級驗證的例子。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「構架附加阻尼識別」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Passing every damper test does not guarantee the structure receives its design damping, because brace stiffness, pin clearance and non-structural elements all intervene. After completion, forced vibration, pull-back tests or strong-motion records identify frequencies and damping ratios; since the equivalent damping of nonlinear dampers varies with amplitude, ambient vibration can only show whether devices are stuck or loose, and real added damping must be verified at larger amplitude. After damping devices were installed on London's Millennium Bridge, Arup confirmed with a controlled walk of about 2,000 people that the lateral sway had been suppressed, an example of system-level verification. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Frame added-damping identification” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單自由度近似：m = 1,250 t、k = 50,000 kN/m，ω = √(k/m) ≈ 6.32 rad/s（約 1.0 Hz），臨界阻尼 c_cr = 2√(km) ≈ 15,800 kN·s/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Single-degree-of-freedom approximation: m = 1,250 t and k = 50,000 kN/m give ω = √(k/m) ≈ 6.32 rad/s (about 1.0 Hz) and critical damping c_cr = 2√(km) ≈ 15,800 kN·s/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「構架附加阻尼識別」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Frame added-damping identification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完工系統識別與實測驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Post-completion system identification and field verification
knowledge.text: 阻尼器逐件合格不等於整個結構得到設計的附加阻尼，因為斜撐勁度、插銷間隙與非結構構件都會影響。完工後可用強制振動、拉放試驗或強震紀錄辨識結構頻率與阻尼比；非線性阻尼器的等效阻尼隨振幅改變，環境微振動只能檢查有無卡死或間隙，真正的附加阻尼要在較大振幅下驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Passing every damper test does not guarantee the structure receives its design damping, because brace stiffness, pin clearance and non-structural elements all intervene. After completion, forced vibration, pull-back tests or strong-motion records identify frequencies and damping ratios; since the equivalent damping of nonlinear dampers varies with amplitude, ambient vibration can only show whether devices are stuck or loose, and real added damping must be verified at larger amplitude.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完工系統識別與實測驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-completion system identification and field verification" is correct?
options: 用環境微振動量到的阻尼比，就能代表地震時阻尼器提供的附加阻尼。
黏滯阻尼器是密封元件，設計壽命內不需要任何檢查或試驗。
阻尼器逐件合格不等於整個結構得到設計的附加阻尼，因為斜撐勁度、插銷間隙與非結構構件都會影響。
optionsEn: Damping measured from ambient vibration represents the added damping the dampers provide in an earthquake.
A viscous damper is a sealed unit, so it needs no inspection or testing during its design life.
Passing every damper test does not guarantee the structure receives its design damping, because brace stiffness, pin clearance and non-structural elements all intervene.
quiz.explanation: 阻尼器逐件合格不等於整個結構得到設計的附加阻尼，因為斜撐勁度、插銷間隙與非結構構件都會影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Passing every damper test does not guarantee the structure receives its design damping, because brace stiffness, pin clearance and non-structural elements all intervene. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完工系統識別與實測驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-completion system identification and field verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「構架附加阻尼識別」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frame added-damping identification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單自由度近似：m = 1,250 t、k = 50,000 kN/m，ω = √(k/m) ≈ 6.32 rad/s（約 1.0 Hz），臨界阻尼 c_cr = 2√(km) ≈ 15,800 kN·s/m。兩具 1,000 kN·s/m 的線性阻尼器以 35° 斜撐配置，水平等效 C_h = 2×1,000×cos²35° ≈ 1,342 kN·s/m，附加阻尼 ζ ≈ 1,342/15,800 ≈ 8.5%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Single-degree-of-freedom approximation: m = 1,250 t and k = 50,000 kN/m give ω = √(k/m) ≈ 6.32 rad/s (about 1.0 Hz) and critical damping c_cr = 2√(km) ≈ 15,800 kN·s/m. Two linear dampers of 1,000 kN·s/m on 35° braces give a horizontal equivalent C_h = 2×1,000×cos²35° ≈ 1,342 kN·s/m and added damping ζ ≈ 1,342/15,800 ≈ 8.5%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在結構上安裝加速度計與阻尼器位移計，比較阻尼器相對位移與層間變位的比值是否接近幾何預測（例如 cos35° ≈ 0.82）；地震後以紀錄反算各層阻尼器力與耗能，與設計需求表比較，差異過大的位置優先檢查斜撐與插銷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Install accelerometers and damper displacement transducers and check that the ratio of damper stroke to storey drift is close to the geometric prediction, for example cos35° ≈ 0.82; after an earthquake back-calculate damper force and energy for each level from the records and compare with the design demand table, inspecting braces and pins first where differences are large.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單自由度近似：m = 1,250 t、k = 50,000 kN/m，ω = √(k/m) ≈ 6.32 rad/s（約 1.0 Hz），臨界阻尼 c_cr = 2√(km) ≈ 15,800 kN·s/m。兩具 1,000 kN·s/m 的線性阻尼器以 35° 斜撐配置，水平等效 C_h = 2×1,000×cos²35° ≈ 1,342 kN·s/m，附加阻尼 ζ ≈ 1,342/15,800 ≈ 8.5%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Single-degree-of-freedom approximation: m = 1,250 t and k = 50,000 kN/m give ω = √(k/m) ≈ 6.32 rad/s (about 1.0 Hz) and critical damping c_cr = 2√(km) ≈ 15,800 kN·s/m. Two linear dampers of 1,000 kN·s/m on 35° braces give a horizontal equivalent C_h = 2×1,000×cos²35° ≈ 1,342 kN·s/m and added damping ζ ≈ 1,342/15,800 ≈ 8.5%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 完工系統識別與實測驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-completion system identification and field verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「構架附加阻尼識別」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frame added-damping identification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在結構上安裝加速度計與阻尼器位移計，比較阻尼器相對位移與層間變位的比值是否接近幾何預測（例如 cos35° ≈ 0.82）；地震後以紀錄反算各層阻尼器力與耗能，與設計需求表比較，差異過大的位置優先檢查斜撐與插銷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Install accelerometers and damper displacement transducers and check that the ratio of damper stroke to storey drift is close to the geometric prediction, for example cos35° ≈ 0.82; after an earthquake back-calculate damper force and energy for each level from the records and compare with the design demand table, inspecting braces and pins first where differences are large. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plan locations and cable routes for damper displacement transducers and strong-motion instruments at design stage; the owner's long-term monitoring contract should include an automatic post-earthquake summary of damper strokes and forces.

Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期」與「地震後評估、更換判斷與交接」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals" and "Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「密封磨耗與滲油檢查」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seal wear and leak inspection” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 建築耐震用阻尼器多半長期靜止，橋梁或人行橋阻尼器則幾乎持續動作，兩者劣化機制不同：前者擔心密封長期靜置後的黏著與油品老化，後者擔心密封磨耗與疲勞。Taylor Devices 公開說明千禧橋的 37 具阻尼器以 50 年以上、約 2×10⁹ 次循環設計，中間與主要檢查及試驗均未見劣化；其長期案例研究也提到某人行橋阻尼器在第 7 年做中間檢查、第 11 年做全面檢查，拆下 3 具動態試驗後重新安裝。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「密封磨耗與滲油檢查」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seismic building dampers mostly sit still for years, whereas bridge and footbridge dampers move almost continuously, so their deterioration differs: the former risk seal sticking and fluid ageing after long rest, the latter seal wear and fatigue. Taylor Devices states that the 37 Millennium Bridge dampers were designed for more than 50 years and about 2×10⁹ cycles, and that intermediate and principal inspections and tests found no degradation; its long-term case study of a footbridge describes an intermediate inspection at seven years and a comprehensive one at eleven years, with three dampers removed, dynamically tested and reinstalled. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Seal wear and leak inspection” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：2×10⁹ 次循環 ÷（50 年×365.25 天×86,400 s）≈ 1.27 次/秒，相當於約 1.3 Hz 的連續擺動；若每循環活塞往返滑動 4 mm，50 年密封累積滑動距離約 2×10⁹×4 mm = 8,000 km。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: 2×10⁹ cycles ÷ (50 years × 365.25 days × 86,400 s) ≈ 1.27 cycles per second, equivalent to continuous motion at about 1.3 Hz; if the piston slides 4 mm per cycle, the seals travel about 2×10⁹×4 mm = 8,000 km in 50 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「黏滯阻尼器是密封元件，設計壽命內不需要任何檢查或試驗。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A viscous damper is a sealed unit, so it needs no inspection or testing during its design life." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「密封磨耗與滲油檢查」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Seal wear and leak inspection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals" is correct?
options: 建築耐震用阻尼器多半長期靜止，橋梁或人行橋阻尼器則幾乎持續動作，兩者劣化機制不同：前者擔心密封長期靜置後的黏著與油品老化，後者擔心密封磨耗與疲勞。

steps.title: 長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密封磨耗與滲油檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seal wear and leak inspection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：2×10⁹ 次循環 ÷（50 年×365.25 天×86,400 s）≈ 1.27 次/秒，相當於約 1.3 Hz 的連續擺動；若每循環活塞往返滑動 4 mm，50 年密封累積滑動距離約 2×10⁹×4 mm = 8,000 km。4 mm 為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: 2×10⁹ cycles ÷ (50 years × 365.25 days × 86,400 s) ≈ 1.27 cycles per second, equivalent to continuous motion at about 1.3 Hz; if the piston slides 4 mm per cycle, the seals travel about 2×10⁹×4 mm = 8,000 km in 50 years. The 4 mm is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期目視檢查漏油、活塞桿刮痕、保護罩、插銷與球面軸承鏽蝕，量測外露桿長確認行程中心；依合約週期抽樣拆下阻尼器回試驗機復驗，C 與 α 與出廠值比較，超出允許偏差即擴大抽樣或更換。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Periodically inspect for leaks, rod scratches, boots, pins and spherical-bearing corrosion, and measure exposed rod length to confirm the stroke centre; at contract intervals remove sample dampers for re-testing on a machine, compare C and α with factory values, and extend sampling or replace units when tolerances are exceeded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals", which statement holds?
options: 阻尼指數 α 越小越好，因為最大力被限制住了。

A damper's effectiveness depends only on the damper and not on brace or connection stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 2×10⁹ 次循環 ÷（50 年×365.25 天×86,400 s）≈ 1.27 次/秒，相當於約 1.3 Hz 的連續擺動；若每循環活塞往返滑動 4 mm，50 年密封累積滑動距離約 2×10⁹×4 mm = 8,000 km。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: 2×10⁹ cycles ÷ (50 years × 365.25 days × 86,400 s) ≈ 1.27 cycles per second, equivalent to continuous motion at about 1.3 Hz; if the piston slides 4 mm per cycle, the seals travel about 2×10⁹×4 mm = 8,000 km in 50 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密封磨耗與滲油檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seal wear and leak inspection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期目視檢查漏油、活塞桿刮痕、保護罩、插銷與球面軸承鏽蝕，量測外露桿長確認行程中心；依合約週期抽樣拆下阻尼器回試驗機復驗，C 與 α 與出廠值比較，超出允許偏差即擴大抽樣或更換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Periodically inspect for leaks, rod scratches, boots, pins and spherical-bearing corrosion, and measure exposed rod length to confirm the stroke centre; at contract intervals remove sample dampers for re-testing on a machine, compare C and α with factory values, and extend sampling or replace units when tolerances are exceeded. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維護手冊要寫明檢查週期、目視項目、桿長紀錄表、抽樣復驗的數量與觸發條件，並保留備品或可替換設計；阻尼器位置須保留拆卸與吊運空間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The maintenance manual should state inspection intervals, visual items, a rod-length log, sample re-test quantities and triggers, and keep spares or a replaceable design; leave space around each damper for removal and handling.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：保護罩破損讓雨水與粉塵進入，活塞桿生鏽並刮傷密封，漏油後阻尼力下降；若檢查只看外觀而從未抽樣復驗，內部油品劣化或氣泡增加可能多年未被發現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A torn boot admits rain and dust, the rod rusts and scores the seals, and leakage reduces damping force; if inspections only look at the outside and never re-test samples, internal fluid degradation or entrained air can go unnoticed for years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
黏滯阻尼器在任何溫度、任何時間點安裝都一樣，因為慢速變形不會產生力。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A viscous damper can be installed at any temperature and time, because slow deformation creates no force.
Periodically inspect for leaks, rod scratches, boots, pins and spherical-bearing corrosion, and measure exposed rod length to confirm the stroke centre.

Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密封磨耗與滲油檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seal wear and leak inspection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 保護罩破損讓雨水與粉塵進入，活塞桿生鏽並刮傷密封，漏油後阻尼力下降；若檢查只看外觀而從未抽樣復驗，內部油品劣化或氣泡增加可能多年未被發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A torn boot admits rain and dust, the rod rusts and scores the seals, and leakage reduces damping force; if inspections only look at the outside and never re-test samples, internal fluid degradation or entrained air can go unnoticed for years. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Taylor Devices 公開說明千禧橋的 37 具阻尼器以 50 年以上、約 2×10⁹ 次循環設計，中間與主要檢查及試驗均未見劣化；其長期案例研究也提到某人行橋阻尼器在第 7 年做中間檢查、第 11 年做全面檢查，拆下 3 具動態試驗後重新安裝。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Taylor Devices states that the 37 Millennium Bridge dampers were designed for more than 50 years and about 2×10⁹ cycles, and that intermediate and principal inspections and tests found no degradation; its long-term case study of a footbridge describes an intermediate inspection at seven years and a comprehensive one at eleven years, with three dampers removed, dynamically tested and reinstalled.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「黏滯阻尼器是密封元件，設計壽命內不需要任何檢查或試驗。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A viscous damper is a sealed unit, so it needs no inspection or testing during its design life." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 保護罩破損讓雨水與粉塵進入，活塞桿生鏽並刮傷密封，漏油後阻尼力下降；若檢查只看外觀而從未抽樣復驗，內部油品劣化或氣泡增加可能多年未被發現。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期耐久、抽樣復驗與檢查週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term durability, sample re-testing and inspection intervals" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 保護罩破損讓雨水與粉塵進入，活塞桿生鏽並刮傷密封，漏油後阻尼力下降；若檢查只看外觀而從未抽樣復驗，內部油品劣化或氣泡增加可能多年未被發現。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。
optionsEn: A torn boot admits rain and dust, the rod rusts and scores the seals, and leakage reduces damping force.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
If a damper shows no leakage after an earthquake, it is completely undamaged.
quiz.explanation: 保護罩破損讓雨水與粉塵進入，活塞桿生鏽並刮傷密封，漏油後阻尼力下降；若檢查只看外觀而從未抽樣復驗，內部油品劣化或氣泡增加可能多年未被發現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A torn boot admits rain and dust, the rod rusts and scores the seals, and leakage reduces damping force; if inspections only look at the outside and never re-test samples, internal fluid degradation or entrained air can go unnoticed for years. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地震後評估、更換判斷與交接：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「地震後評估紀錄」如何影響黏滯阻尼器性能驗證的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-earthquake assessment record” governs force, deformation or durability in “Viscous-damper performance verification”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 大地震後，阻尼器可能已接近最大行程、承受接近額定的力，或因溫升與高壓損傷密封；工程師須在短時間內判斷結構能否繼續使用。製造商公開說明 Torre Mayor 在 2017 年規模 7.1 地震後無損傷並於當天重新開放，顯示事前準備的檢查程序與阻尼器本身的可靠性同樣重要。評估流程應結合強震紀錄反算的需求、現場目視、桿長與漏油檢查，再決定是否抽樣拆下復驗或更換。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「地震後評估紀錄」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After a major earthquake, dampers may have neared full stroke, carried close to rated force or suffered seal damage from heat and pressure, and engineers must decide quickly whether the structure can stay in use. The manufacturer reports that Torre Mayor was undamaged in the magnitude 7.1 earthquake of 2017 and reopened the same day, showing that a prepared inspection procedure matters as much as damper reliability. Assessment should combine demands back-calculated from strong-motion records with visual, rod-length and leak checks before deciding whether to remove samples for re-testing or to replace units. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-earthquake assessment record” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：由強震紀錄得阻尼器軸向變形幅值 40 mm、主要週期 2.0 s（0.5 Hz），尖峰速度約 v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s；以 C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4，F ≈ 1,500×0.126^0.4 ≈ 654 kN，約為 1,500 kN 設計力的 44%，屬中度需求，以目視與桿長檢查為主。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Records show a damper axial deformation amplitude of 40 mm at a dominant period of 2.0 s (0.5 Hz), so peak velocity is about v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s; with C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4, F ≈ 1,500×0.126^0.4 ≈ 654 kN, about 44% of the 1,500 kN design force, a moderate demand handled mainly by visual and rod-length checks.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If a damper shows no leakage after an earthquake, it is completely undamaged." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「地震後評估紀錄」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-earthquake assessment record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover

knowledge.text: 誤解：地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「地震後評估、更換判斷與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover" is correct?
options: 地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。
大地震後，阻尼器可能已接近最大行程、承受接近額定的力，或因溫升與高壓損傷密封；工程師須在短時間內判斷結構能否繼續使用。
加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。

quiz.explanationEn: After a major earthquake, dampers may have neared full stroke, carried close to rated force or suffered seal damage from heat and pressure, and engineers must decide quickly whether the structure can stay in use. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地震後評估、更換判斷與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地震後評估紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-earthquake assessment record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：由強震紀錄得阻尼器軸向變形幅值 40 mm、主要週期 2.0 s（0.5 Hz），尖峰速度約 v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s；以 C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4，F ≈ 1,500×0.126^0.4 ≈ 654 kN，約為 1,500 kN 設計力的 44%，屬中度需求，以目視與桿長檢查為主。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Records show a damper axial deformation amplitude of 40 mm at a dominant period of 2.0 s (0.5 Hz), so peak velocity is about v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s; with C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4, F ≈ 1,500×0.126^0.4 ≈ 654 kN, about 44% of the 1,500 kN design force, a moderate demand handled mainly by visual and rod-length checks. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：事件後依檢查表逐具記錄漏油、桿面刮痕、端部碰撞痕跡、插銷與節點板變形及外露桿長，對照紀錄反算的最大行程與力；需求超過設計值一定比例（例如 80%）的阻尼器列入抽樣復驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After an event, record for every damper leaks, rod scratches, end-stop impact marks, pin and gusset deformation and exposed rod length against a checklist, and compare with peak stroke and force back-calculated from records; dampers whose demand exceeded a set fraction of design, for example 80%, go into the sample re-test group.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地震後評估、更換判斷與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover", which statement holds?
options: 只要阻尼器外觀沒有油漬，內部一定沒有問題。
同一批次阻尼器只要抽驗一具合格，其他都不必試驗。
由強震紀錄得阻尼器軸向變形幅值 40 mm、主要週期 2.0 s（0.5 Hz），尖峰速度約 v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s。
optionsEn: If a damper shows no oil stains outside, nothing can be wrong inside.
If one damper from a batch passes, the rest of the batch need not be tested.
Records show a damper axial deformation amplitude of 40 mm at a dominant period of 2.0 s (0.5 Hz), so peak velocity is about v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 由強震紀錄得阻尼器軸向變形幅值 40 mm、主要週期 2.0 s（0.5 Hz），尖峰速度約 v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s；以 C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4、α = 0.4，F ≈ 1,500×0.126^0.4 ≈ 654 kN，約為 1,500 kN 設計力的 44%，屬中度需求，以目視與桿長檢查為主。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Records show a damper axial deformation amplitude of 40 mm at a dominant period of 2.0 s (0.5 Hz), so peak velocity is about v = 2π×0.5×0.040 ≈ 0.126 m/s; with C = 1,500 kN·(s/m)^0.4 and α = 0.4, F ≈ 1,500×0.126^0.4 ≈ 654 kN, about 44% of the 1,500 kN design force, a moderate demand handled mainly by visual and rod-length checks. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地震後評估、更換判斷與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地震後評估紀錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-earthquake assessment record” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 事件後依檢查表逐具記錄漏油、桿面刮痕、端部碰撞痕跡、插銷與節點板變形及外露桿長，對照紀錄反算的最大行程與力；需求超過設計值一定比例（例如 80%）的阻尼器列入抽樣復驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After an event, record for every damper leaks, rod scratches, end-stop impact marks, pin and gusset deformation and exposed rod length against a checklist, and compare with peak stroke and force back-calculated from records; dampers whose demand exceeded a set fraction of design, for example 80%, go into the sample re-test group. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接文件應包含阻尼器編號與位置圖、原型與出廠試驗報告、安裝桿長與溫度紀錄、檢查與復驗程序及事件後檢查表；用途變更或增設樓層前，須由結構設計者評估阻尼器需求並核可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Handover documents should contain the numbered location plan, prototype and production test reports, installation rod-length and temperature records, inspection and re-test procedures and the post-event checklist; before a change of use or added storeys, the structural designer must assess damper demands and approve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若沒有事件前的桿長與外觀基準，事後無法判斷殘留偏移或滲油是新發生還是舊有；未經評估就恢復使用，可能讓已受損的阻尼器在餘震中失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Without pre-event rod-length and appearance baselines, nobody can tell whether residual offset or seepage is new or old; returning to service without assessment can let a damaged damper fail in an aftershock. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 事件後依檢查表逐具記錄漏油、桿面刮痕、端部碰撞痕跡、插銷與節點板變形及外露桿長，對照紀錄反算的最大行程與力；需求超過設計值一定比例（例如 80%）的阻尼器列入抽樣復驗。
knowledge.textEn: After an event, record for every damper leaks, rod scratches, end-stop impact marks, pin and gusset deformation and exposed rod length against a checklist, and compare with peak stroke and force back-calculated from records; dampers whose demand exceeded a set fraction of design, for example 80%, go into the sample re-test group.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接文件應包含阻尼器編號與位置圖、原型與出廠試驗報告、安裝桿長與溫度紀錄、檢查與復驗程序及事件後檢查表；用途變更或增設樓層前，須由結構設計者評估阻尼器需求並核可。
knowledge.textEn: Handover documents should contain the numbered location plan, prototype and production test reports, installation rod-length and temperature records, inspection and re-test procedures and the post-event checklist; before a change of use or added storeys, the structural designer must assess damper demands and approve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地震後評估、更換判斷與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover"?
options: 事件後依檢查表逐具記錄漏油、桿面刮痕、端部碰撞痕跡、插銷與節點板變形及外露桿長，對照紀錄反算的最大行程與力。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
地震只有幾十秒，阻尼器不必考慮發熱問題。
optionsEn: After an event, record for every damper leaks, rod scratches, end-stop impact marks, pin and gusset deformation and exposed rod length against a checklist, and compare with peak stroke and force back-calculated from records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An earthquake lasts only tens of seconds, so damper heating can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 事件後依檢查表逐具記錄漏油、桿面刮痕、端部碰撞痕跡、插銷與節點板變形及外露桿長，對照紀錄反算的最大行程與力；需求超過設計值一定比例（例如 80%）的阻尼器列入抽樣復驗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After an event, record for every damper leaks, rod scratches, end-stop impact marks, pin and gusset deformation and exposed rod length against a checklist, and compare with peak stroke and force back-calculated from records; dampers whose demand exceeded a set fraction of design, for example 80%, go into the sample re-test group. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地震後評估、更換判斷與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地震後評估紀錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-earthquake assessment record” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若沒有事件前的桿長與外觀基準，事後無法判斷殘留偏移或滲油是新發生還是舊有；未經評估就恢復使用，可能讓已受損的阻尼器在餘震中失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Without pre-event rod-length and appearance baselines, nobody can tell whether residual offset or seepage is new or old; returning to service without assessment can let a damaged damper fail in an aftershock. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：評估流程應結合強震紀錄反算的需求、現場目視、桿長與漏油檢查，再決定是否抽樣拆下復驗或更換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assessment should combine demands back-calculated from strong-motion records with visual, rod-length and leak checks before deciding whether to remove samples for re-testing or to replace units.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「地震後阻尼器沒有漏油，就代表它完全沒有受損。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If a damper shows no leakage after an earthquake, it is completely undamaged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若沒有事件前的桿長與外觀基準，事後無法判斷殘留偏移或滲油是新發生還是舊有；未經評估就恢復使用，可能讓已受損的阻尼器在餘震中失效。
knowledge.textEn: Without pre-event rod-length and appearance baselines, nobody can tell whether residual offset or seepage is new or old; returning to service without assessment can let a damaged damper fail in an aftershock.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地震後評估、更換判斷與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-earthquake assessment, replacement decisions and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若沒有事件前的桿長與外觀基準，事後無法判斷殘留偏移或滲油是新發生還是舊有；未經評估就恢復使用，可能讓已受損的阻尼器在餘震中失效。
加裝黏滯阻尼器會讓結構變硬，所以柱與基礎的內力一定增加。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Without pre-event rod-length and appearance baselines, nobody can tell whether residual offset or seepage is new or old.
Adding viscous dampers stiffens the structure, so column and foundation forces must increase.
quiz.explanation: 若沒有事件前的桿長與外觀基準，事後無法判斷殘留偏移或滲油是新發生還是舊有；未經評估就恢復使用，可能讓已受損的阻尼器在餘震中失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Without pre-event rod-length and appearance baselines, nobody can tell whether residual offset or seepage is new or old; returning to service without assessment can let a damaged damper fail in an aftershock. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
